questions.question: Nehemiah angrily rebuked the Jewish nobles and officials. What did he say they were doing?

answers.text: Charging interest to their own brothers
Skipping their shifts on the wall
Hiding grain from the king's men

questions.question: After the nobles promised to give back what they took from the poor, whom did Nehemiah summon while requiring an oath of them?
What did Nehemiah ask God to do to anyone who broke the nobles' promise to the poor?

answers.text: Shake him out of his house

questions.question: Why did Governor Nehemiah refuse the governor's food allowance, even while feeding many people at his table?

answers.text: The people's burden was so heavy
The nobles paid for it all
